task_description: Build an additive, WordPress-style custom admin editor at /admin for Coinscribed (Next.js 14 + Sanity). It authenticates each writer with their OWN Sanity account (multi-user, Editor/Admin roles managed in manage.sanity.io) and writes back into the SAME Sanity dataset AS THE LOGGED-IN USER (no master write token). Core deliverables: protected /admin dashboard + Studio-like shell; full article editor (title, auto slug, excerpt, author/category pickers, publishedAt, SEO title<=70/description<=160, FAQs); a rich-text body editor emitting valid Portable Text matching data/sample-news.ts + PortableTextRenderer.tsx; featured + inline image upload to Sanity assets as the user; and THE headline feature - an easy spreadsheet-style visual TABLE editor that serializes to the existing tableBlock shape (caption?, header:string[], rows:[{_type:'row',cells:string[]}]) so tables render identically and stay Studio-editable; plus Draft/Publish via the drafts.<id> convention. /studio and the public site remain untouched.
